title: Truchas 2D simulation controls
description: Time-step controls and output schedule for a time-dependent 2D simulation.

initial-time.description: Simulation time at which the initial state is established. The default is zero.

initial-time-step.description: Initial time-step size. It must be strictly positive.

min-time-step.description: Smallest permitted time-step size. It must be strictly positive and no greater than initial-time-step.

final-time.description: Optional final simulation time. It must be greater than initial-time and no earlier than the last output time; by default it equals the last entry in output-times.times.

max-time-step.description: Largest permitted time-step size. It must be at least initial-time-step; if omitted, the implementation uses an effectively unbounded maximum.

time-step-growth.description: Maximum factor by which a successful time step may grow the next time step. The value must be at least one; the default is 1.05.

time-step-lookahead.description: Number of future time-step synchronization points considered by coupled time integration. The default is three.

times.description: Strictly increasing target output times. At least one time must be supplied, and at least one must be later than initial-time.

subintervals.description: Optional number of equally spaced output subintervals between consecutive entries in times. Supply one fewer value than the number of times; the default is one for every interval.
